safe_area.reason: Mounting frames, structural supports and viewing angle all eat into the physical edge of an out-of-home surface, and the exact loss is not known at design time. Everything that carries the message is kept well inside the panel.

structural_rules.focal_requirement: One idea, readable in under two seconds by someone moving past. There is no second glance, so a second message is not a smaller line, it is a different panel.
